findings.description: P = (11.6 - 3.3) x 0.30 = 2.49 W, not 0.25 W; Tj = 60 + 2.49 x 60 = 209 C, far above the 125 C limit of REQ-ELEC-003.
External M12 bus pins go straight to U3 with no TVS; REQ-ELEC-005 requires +/-8 kV IEC 61000-4-2.
Reverse-polarity requirement (Verify: test) has no test in the plan or trace.
Certified claim with no test evidence; certification needs L5 evidence from an accredited lab.
AMS1117 needs >= 22 uF tantalum (ESR >= 0.3 ohm) at the output for stability; C3 is 1 uF X7R, so the regulator may oscillate.
Pigtail soldered straight into J1 pads through a loose grommet; nothing takes the 20 N pull of REQ-MECH-001.
